title: gibasis triflora
intro: Gibasis triflora, commonly known as Mexican prickly poppy, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and Central America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Gibasis triflora include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Gibasis triflora include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
